vehicleDetails.title: 450 X Pro
vehicleDetails.description:
The Ather 450X Pro stands as a high-performance flagship within the Ather 450 series, offering advanced rider-assist technology, premium connectivity, and exhilarating performance. It is available with two battery configurations—2.9 kWh and 3.7 kWh—each designed to cater to different range and endurance needs.

Performance & Specifications

The 450X Pro series is powered by a potent 6.4 kW PMSM motor, delivering instant torque for quick acceleration.

Key "Pro" Features & Technology

Upgrading to the Pro configuration unlocks the full suite of Ather’s smart features and safety enhancements:

  • Premium Rider Assists: Includes AutoHold™ (maintains stability on inclines), FallSafe™ (motor cut-off during falls), and Multi-Mode Traction Control™ for confident riding across varied road surfaces.
  • Smart Dashboard: Features a 7-inch TFT touchscreen with Google Maps navigation, real-time cricket scores, WhatsApp alerts, and call/music control directly on the dash.
  • Convenience Tech: Equipped with Magic Twist™ (regenerative braking control), Park Assist™ (reverse mode), and Infinite Cruise™ for stress-free city riding.
  • Advanced Security: Includes ParkSafe™, LockSafe™, and app-based theft and tow alerts to keep the scooter secure.

Why Choose the 450X Pro?

The Ather 450X Pro is the ideal choice for riders who want a high-tech, performance-oriented daily commuter.

  • Choose the 2.9 kWh variant if your daily travel is primarily localized and you prefer a lighter, more agile scooter for city traffic.
  • Choose the 3.7 kWh variant if you require maximum range for longer inter-city commutes or prefer the peace of mind that comes with a larger battery capacity.

Both variants maintain the signature sporty handling, lightweight aluminium chassis, and sharp disc-braking system that make the Ather 450 series a leader in the electric scooter segment.

variantData.metaTitle: Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh): Price, Range, Images, Features | EVINDIA
variantData.description:
The Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) is the definitive smart scooter for the tech-obsessed city rider. It takes the aggressive, high-performance hardware of the 450X and completely unlocks its digital potential through the integrated Pro Pack. Designed for commuters who want the absolute best in touchscreen connectivity, navigation, and thrilling acceleration, this variant delivers a no-compromise flagship experience perfectly sized for everyday urban travel.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Warp Mode Unleashed: Upgrading to the Pro version gives you full access to Ather's legendary riding modes, including the adrenaline-pumping Warp Mode. Paired with the potent 6.4 kW PMSM motor, it rockets from 0–40 km/h in a blistering 3.3 seconds.
  • Fully Connected Touchscreen: The Pro Pack brings the 7-inch TFT Touchscreen to life. It unlocks built-in Google Maps for seamless Turn-by-Turn navigation, Bluetooth connectivity for call and music controls, document storage, and real-time ride statistics synchronized with your smartphone.
  • Premium Rider Assists: The software upgrade introduces advanced safety and convenience features like AutoHold™ (keeping the scooter perfectly still on inclines without holding the brakes) and FallSafe™ technology.
  • City-Optimized Range: Powered by the lighter 2.9 kWh Lithium-ion battery, it delivers a highly reliable 111 km IDC range, providing the perfect amount of energy for daily office commutes and localized errands.

Variant Comparison: The "Pro" Advantage

The Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) sits at the intersection of premium technology and urban practicality. Here is how it compares to the rest of the 450 lineup.

1. Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450X (2.9 kWh): The Software Unlock

This is the most direct comparison: the standard model versus the fully unlocked model.

  • Hardware Parity: Both scooters are physically identical, sharing the same 2.9 kWh battery, 6.4 kW motor, and physical TFT screen.
  • The "Pro" Difference: The standard Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) offers a basic software experience without navigation or connectivity. The Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) unlocks the screen's full potential, adding integrated Google Maps, Bluetooth controls, AutoHold™, and the ultra-aggressive Warp Mode.
  • Verdict: If you just want the physical scooter, the standard 450X works. If you want a "smart" scooter that connects to your phone, guides you through traffic, and gives you maximum acceleration, the Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) is the mandatory upgrade.

2. Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh): The Range Extension

If you know you want all the Pro software and the high-output motor, your decision comes down entirely to battery size.

  • Identical Experience: Both scooters feature the fully unlocked TFT touchscreen, Warp Mode, AutoHold™, and aggressive styling.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) delivers a 111 km IDC range, perfect for localized city riding. The Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) utilizes the flagship battery pack to push that range up to a massive 150 km IDC.
  • Verdict: If your daily travel is short and predictable, the Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) saves you weight and perfectly fits your routine. If you travel inter-city or want maximum peace of mind between charges, the 3.7 kWh variant is the necessary upgrade.

3. Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh): Display & Power Upgrade

This comparison determines whether you prefer tactile switches or a premium touchscreen.

  • Shared Connectivity: Both the "S Pro" and the "X Pro" utilize the 2.9 kWh battery and offer fully unlocked smart features like Bluetooth, navigation, and AutoHold™.
  • The "X" Factor: The Ather 450S Pro (2.9 kWh) uses a physical DeepView™ LCD display and a 5.4 kW motor. The Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) upgrades the experience to a full, vibrant TFT Touchscreen and increases the motor power to 6.4 kW, dropping the 0-40 km/h time to 3.3 seconds.
  • Verdict: If you prefer physical switches and a lower profile, the 450S Pro is excellent. If you want a smartphone-like interactive screen and sports-car acceleration, you must choose the Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh).

Why Choose the Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh)?

The Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) is the ultimate "no-compromises" machine for the dedicated city rider. It provides the absolute highest level of technology Ather offers—Google Maps, Bluetooth, and Warp Mode—without forcing you to carry a larger, heavier battery you might not need for your daily 20 km commute. It is fast, incredibly smart, and perfectly balanced for the urban jungle.

variantData.description:
The Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) is the absolute zenith of Ather’s engineering. It leaves nothing on the table, combining the brand's most powerful motor, the largest available battery pack, and the fully unlocked Pro software suite. Designed for the uncompromising enthusiast who demands maximum driving range, sports-car-like acceleration, and a fully connected smart touchscreen experience, this is the definitive flagship. If you want everything Ather has to offer in one flawless package, this is the machine for you.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Marathon Endurance: Equipped with the flagship 3.7 kWh Lithium-ion battery, it completely eliminates range anxiety. Delivering a massive 150 km IDC range (with a real-world TrueRange™ of 110 km), it comfortably handles long inter-city commutes and multi-day riding on a single charge.
  • Warp Mode Unleashed: Upgrading to the Pro version gives you full access to Ather's legendary riding modes, including the adrenaline-pumping Warp Mode. Paired with the potent 6.4 kW PMSM motor and 26 Nm of peak torque, it rockets from 0–40 km/h in a blistering 3.3 seconds.
  • Fully Connected Touchscreen: The Pro Pack brings the IP65-rated 7-inch TFT Touchscreen to life. It unlocks built-in Google Maps for seamless Turn-by-Turn navigation, Bluetooth connectivity for call and music controls, document storage, and real-time ride statistics pushed to your smartphone.
  • Premium Rider Assists: The software upgrade introduces advanced safety and convenience features like AutoHold™ (keeping the scooter perfectly still on inclines without holding the brakes), FallSafe™ technology, and Guide-me-home lights.

Variant Comparison: The Top of the Ather Mountain

As the absolute flagship, the Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) sits above all others. Here is how it justifies its position compared to the models sitting just below it.

1. Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450X (3.7 kWh): The Pro Software Unlock

This comparison determines whether you want the basic flagship hardware or the fully unlocked smart experience.

  • Hardware Parity: Both models are physically identical, sharing the massive 3.7 kWh battery, 6.4 kW motor, and the physical TFT screen.
  • The "Pro" Difference: The standard Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) offers a basic software experience without navigation or connectivity. The Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) unlocks the screen's full potential, giving you integrated Google Maps, Bluetooth controls, AutoHold™, and the ultra-aggressive Warp Mode.
  • Verdict: Choose the standard model if you simply want the physical performance and range. If you want your dashboard to act like a fully connected smart device with built-in navigation and maximum acceleration modes, you must opt for the Pro variant.

2. Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh): The Range Extension

If you know you want all the Pro software and the high-output motor, your decision comes down entirely to battery size.

  • Identical Experience: Both scooters feature the fully unlocked TFT touchscreen, Warp Mode, AutoHold™, and aggressive styling.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) delivers a 111 km IDC range, which is perfect for localized city riding. The Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) utilizes the flagship battery pack to push that range up to an expansive 150 km IDC.
  • Verdict: If your daily travel is short and highly predictable, the 2.9 kWh variant saves weight. If you travel inter-city or want maximum peace of mind between charges, the Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) is the necessary upgrade.

3. Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh): Display & Power Upgrade

This comparison is for riders who want the large battery and Pro features but are debating the dashboard and motor power.

  • Shared Endurance: Both models utilize the large 3.7 kWh battery, offering fantastic long-distance commuting capability. Both also feature fully unlocked Pro software like navigation and AutoHold™.
  • Power & Interface: The Ather 450S Pro (3.7 kWh) uses a physical DeepView™ LCD display and a 5.4 kW motor. The Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) upgrades you to the punchy 6.4 kW motor (dropping the 0-40 time to 3.3s) and replaces the LCD with a full TFT Touchscreen with Warp Mode capability.
  • Verdict: Choose the 450S Pro if you want maximum range on a highly durable physical display. Upgrade to the Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) if you want thrilling, class-leading acceleration and a premium, interactive touchscreen cockpit.

Why Choose the Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh)?

The Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) is the ultimate electric scooter for the rider who refuses to settle. It offers the longest range in the lineup, the fastest acceleration, and the smartest dashboard on the market. From dominating the fast lane in Warp Mode to navigating complex city routes via Google Maps, this scooter represents the pinnacle of premium Indian electric mobility.
